booking.forAFriend: Book for a friend in the booking wizard — the confirmation goes straight to them and they just show up.
booking.reschedule: Call at least 24 hours ahead to move an appointment — no charge to reschedule.
booking.steps: Pick a treatment, pick a day and time, add your details, pay a $30 deposit by card at checkout — the rest is paid at your visit.

deposit: Pay a $30 deposit to lock in your time; it is credited to your treatment and you pay the balance at your visit by cash, e-transfer or card.
firstVisit: First visit: a $30 consultation (20 minutes, video or in person), credited in full toward your first treatment. That is the one first-visit offer.
giftAnswer: Gift certificates are easy: gift a Classic Facial ($85), an Anti-Aging Facial ($125), The Works ($160) — or any custom amount. Pay securely by card online, and a certificate code is emailed to your friend to redeem when they book. Gift codes never expire.

hours.private: Early mornings and evenings, by request — the regular price plus $15 per visit. Times are never listed; Sarah arranges them directly.
hours.regular: Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM–4:00 PM. Sundays the studio is closed.

payment: Pay a $30 deposit to lock in your time; it is credited to your treatment and you pay the balance at your visit by cash, e-transfer or card. A plain Interac-only debit card cannot go through the card link — e-transfer covers it. The charge shows as IN2SKIN on card statements. Book without a deposit and your slot is held for 30 minutes, then it opens back up.
